trapfinding.name: Trapfinding
trapfinding.source: CRB, Rogue: "A rogue adds 1/2 her level to Perception skill checks made to locate traps and to Disable Device skill checks (minimum +1)."
not_yet: the Perception half is "to locate traps": no skill roll says what it is looking for, so it is dropped, never applied
"A rogue can use Disable Device to disarm magic traps": no trap op distinguishes them

trap-sense.name: Trap sense
trap-sense.source: CRB, Rogue: "At 3rd level, a rogue gains an intuitive sense that alerts her to danger from traps, giving her a +1 bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps. These bonuses rise to +2 when the rogue reaches 6th level, to +3 when she reaches 9th level, to +4 when she reaches 12th level, to +5 at 15th, and to +6 at 18th level."
not_yet: against: trap — no save or attack roll says it comes from a trap yet, so both terms are dropped, never applied
